purpose: Human-readable reconstruction of the supplied CDP4 iteration export. It resolves IID references into engineering elements, parameter types, units and values.

reference_chain: ElementDefinition contains parameter IIDs and contained ElementUsage IIDs
ElementUsage references an ElementDefinition and may override a parameter
Parameter references a ParameterType and ParameterValueSet
ParameterType is resolved through the supplied CSV
ParameterValueSet values are retained separately; manual is selected as effective when populated
